A fictional student is stressed for an upcoming exam. What is something they can do?

Prepared reply

An upcoming exam can feel like a lot. One practical option is to choose a small revision task, work on that part, and leave room for a break. If you would like a short pause first, mello has one-minute breathing, grounding and STOP practices. You choose whether to use one; it is not a test you have to finish.
